problem: is_empty now uses `or` instead of `and`, so half-open single points like [a,a) and (a,a] are kept as non-empty, and normalize, union, intersection and difference silently return phantom points (e.g. difference(A, A) != [])

The repository has no tests, and the change to the empty-interval rule ships without any test of the four open/closed combinations at lo == hi or the set operations built on them, which is how F1 got through
Already on main: NaN bounds pass is_number and are accepted, so every comparison with them is false and sorting, merging and is_empty give meaningless results with no error
Already on main: validate_bounds only rejects closed None ends, so a closed explicit +-inf is accepted and exported as (None, ..., True), output that normalize rejects when passed back in
